metadata.explanation:
Consistent hash
hash(key) → one shard
Adding or losing a node moves only nearby key ranges.

Shard B
replica 1 · healthy · selected
Serves this read from RAM.

Shard B
replica 2 · healthy
Stores the same shard data.

Shard B
replica 3 · healthy
Stores the same shard data.

Selected write policy
cache-aside reads + database-first writes
The database is updated first. The old cache entry is invalidated. The next read fetches fresh data and repopulates the cache.
Expired or evicted entries are absent; the next read misses, falls back to the authoritative database, and refills the cache.

Cache node down
another healthy replica → read succeeds
No healthy replica → MISS → database → refill.

metadata.explanation:
Popular key expires
many reads miss together
Allow one database read; make duplicate requests wait, then share the result.

Hot key
one shard gets too many requests
Add extra replicas for that item or cache it in the application.
